crossRefs.note: The words of king Lemuel; the revelation which his mother taught him.
We have the more sure word of prophecy; and you do well that you heed it, as to a lamp shining in a dark place, until…

people.name: Agur
people.line: Author of Proverbs 30, son of Jakeh

people.name: Ithiel
people.line: Mentioned in Agur's sayings; meaning uncertain.

people.name: Jakeh
people.line: Father of Agur, the author of Proverbs 30

people.name: Ucal
people.line: Recipient of Agur's wisdom in Proverbs 30

translations.web: The words of Agur the son of Jakeh; the revelation: the man says to Ithiel, to Ithiel and Ucal:
translations.bsb: These are the words of Agur son of Jakeh—the burden that this man declared to Ithiel: “I am weary, O God, and worn out.
translations.kjv: The words of Agur the son of Jakeh, even the prophecy: the man spake unto Ithiel, even unto Ithiel and Ucal,
translations.asv: The words of Agur the son of Jakeh; The oracle. The man saith unto Ithiel, unto Ithiel and Ucal:
